name: Never Ask Me About My Business

meta.wiki: Never Ask Me About My Business

summary: Narain Soothfancy has a plan he refuses to explain, and it calls for a chicken of five hundred pounds. You head for Gadgetzan to speak with Dirge Quikcleave, who can get you started on finding a fitting bird.

sections.title: Planning and Fetching
sections.body: Narain Soothfancy wants no more questions about his business, which deals in things you could never hope to grasp. The planning is his and the fetching is yours. As he said before, the plan needs a chicken of five hundred pounds, and Dirge Quikcleave in the Gadgetzan inn can point you toward one.

sections.title: Dirge's Answer
sections.body: Dirge Quikcleave scratches his head. A chicken of that weight is no longer to be found, he says, though he once knew of one, the Black Chicken of Death, and nobody who saw that bird lived to tell of it. Then he says he has an idea that could be good for you both.

faq.q: Why does Narain Soothfancy need a five-hundred-pound chicken?
aliases: why does narain want a chicken
faq.answer: Narain will not say. His business involves things you could not understand, such as a psychotronic muzzledorf, and he leaves the planning to himself and the fetching to you.

faq.q: Who do you need to talk to in Gadgetzan?
faq.answer: Narain sends you to Dirge Quikcleave, found in the Gadgetzan inn, who will start you on finding a suitable chicken.
Translating the Ledger comes first. Narain Soothfancy raises the matter of the chicken after that.
